back: The penalty shall be applied from the receiving team's 10-yard line.

front: What is the penalty if the ball is loose in the Team B end zone and Team A commits illegal interference preventing Team B from gaining possession? Rule 8 | Section 4 | Article 2 a) 3.
back: No score, B scrimmage 1D at B 10.

front: How is a foul committed by Team B in the Team A end zone on a play from scrimmage penalized? Rule 8 | Section 4 | Article 2 b) 1.
back: The penalty shall be applied as though the foul had occurred on the field of play.

front: What is the penalty if an A player fumbles in their own end zone, and while the ball is loose, Team B commits illegal interference preventing Team A from regaining possession? Rule 8 | Section 4 | Article 2 b) 2.
back: No score by B. Automatic 1st down for Team A at PLS, or at the 10 yard (10 metre) line, at the option of Team A.

front: How are distance penalties for Unnecessary Roughness and Rough Play applied in relation to advantage of distance gained or score made? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 1
back: The distance penalties for Unnecessary Roughness and Rough Play will be applied in addition to the advantage of distance gained and score made.

front: What is the consequence of Unnecessary Roughness or Rough Play by Team B, in addition to the distance penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 1
back: An automatic first down will be awarded to Team A, unless it is part of a dual penalty where both infractions are UR or RP.

front: Do the normal restrictions near the goal line apply to Unnecessary Roughness and Rough Play penalties? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 1
back: No, the normal restrictions near the goal line do NOT apply to Unnecessary Roughness and Rough Play.

front: What is the ball placement if a 15-yard penalty for Unnecessary Roughness or Rough Play is applied from the 16-yard line or closer? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 1
back: The ball will be taken to the 1-yard line.

front: For Scrimmage Plays where a foul occurs before distance is gained, what options does the non-offending team have? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 2
back: The non-offending team shall have the option of having the penalty applied at PLS, DR or of allowing the play to stand and have the penalty applied at PBD, with downs continuing.

front: For Scrimmage Plays where a foul occurs after distance is gained, what options does the non-offending team have for penalty application? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 3
back: The non-offending team shall have the option of having the penalty applied at PBH at the time of the foul, or at the PBD.

front: If the point of application selected for a foul after distance gained results in distance gained, what is the down and distance? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 3
back: 1st Down will be awarded, the penalty applied, and it will be 1D and 10 at the point following the penalty application.

front: If Team A commits a foul on the field of play while the ball is in the A end zone, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: The penalty shall be applied from the PLS (except UR, RP, etc.).

front: If Team B commits a foul on the field of play while the ball is in the B end zone, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: The penalty shall be applied from the B10 yard (10 metre) line (except UR, RP, etc.).

front: If Team A commits a foul on the field of play while the ball is in the B end zone, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: The penalty shall be applied from the B 10 yard (10 metre) line. Team B may request the ball to be placed at any point on or between the hash marks. (UR, RP, etc may be applied at the 10 yard (10 metre) line or at the PBD).

front: If Team B commits a foul on the field of play while the ball is in the A end zone, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: The penalty will be applied at PLS. (UR, RP etc. may be applied at PLS or at the PBD).

front: When a foul occurs before possession is lost during a play in which possession changes (e.g., on a kick, intercepted forward pass, or fumble recovery), where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: Apply penalty at PLS, point of possession, or PBD at the option of the non-offending team.

front: When a foul occurs while the ball is in flight during a play in which possession changes, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: Apply penalty at the point of possession or PBD.

front: When a foul occurs during a loose ball in the area of recovery or affecting the recovery, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: Apply penalty at PF or at the PP, or PBD as appropriate.

front: When a foul occurs during a loose ball in an area remote from the point of recovery and did not affect the recovery, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 4
back: Apply penalty at PP or at the PBD.

front: If time expires during a play in which a foul occurs, what option does the non-offending team have if they accept the penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: Accept the penalty, in which case the team entitled to possession shall be required to put the ball into play and the period extended for that play.

front: If time expires during a play in which a foul occurs, what option does the non-offending team have if they decline the penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: Decline the penalty and accept the play as it terminated, in which case the period is ended.

front: If the last play of a period is terminated by an official’s whistle prior to the ball being put into play, what happens? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The period shall be extended for another play.

front: If Unnecessary Roughness or Rough Play occurs during the last play of a period, what options does the non-offending team have for penalty application? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The non-offending team will have the option to have the penalty applied in the same period, in which case another play will take place, or to have the penalty applied on the opening play of the next period.

front: If a time count foul occurs on a convert during the last play of a period, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The penalty will be applied on a repeated convert, with no option to apply the penalty on the kick off.

front: If a legally scored touchdown is the last play of the period, and UR/RP occurs during the play or interval before the convert, what are the penalty application options? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: 1) on the convert following a touchdown OR 2) on the kick off in the same period OR 3) on a kick off to open the next period.

front: If a foul is committed in the end zone on the last play of the period and the penalty would award a score, what can the non-offending team do? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The non-offending team may accept the penalty and the resultant score, and may also elect to terminate the period.

front: If a legally scored touchdown is the last play of the period, and Objectionable Conduct or No Mouthguard occurs, what are the penalty application options? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: 1) on the convert following the touchdown OR 2) on a kick off to open the next period.

front: If Objectionable Conduct or No Mouthguard occurs on the convert during the last play of a period, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The penalty will be applied on the opening play of the next period.

front: What is the consequence of an offside pass regarding extending play? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: An offside pass is not a foul and does not extend play.

front: When a foul occurs after possession has changed, what options does the non-offending team have for penalty application? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 5
back: The non-offending team shall have the option of having the penalty applied at the PBH at the time of the foul, or at the PBD.

front: If Team A commits UR or RP after Team B gained possession in their own end zone and the ball goes dead in the end zone (not an intercepted FP), what is the penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 6
back: No score. UR 15-yard penalty applied at the 10, B 1D and 10 on B 25. RP – 25-yard penalty applied at the 10, B 1D and 10 on 35 and disqualification.

front: If Team B commits UR or RP after gaining possession in their own end zone and the ball goes dead in the end zone (not an intercepted FP), what is the penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 6
back: Score allowed, UR 15-yard penalty, or RP 25-yard and disqualification, applied on the subsequent play.

front: If Team A or B commits UR or RP after the ball is dead in the end zone (after Team B gained possession, not an intercepted FP), what is the penalty? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 6
back: Score allowed, if applicable. UR 15-yard penalty applied on the subsequent play. RP – disqualification and 25-yard applied on the subsequent play.

front: When an Unnecessary Roughness or Rough Play foul also constitutes illegal interference affecting the recovery of a fumble or loose ball, what are the penalty options for the non-offending team? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 7
back: Option to the non-offending team: L15 (UR) or L25 (RP) at PF, 1D; or L15 (UR) or L25 (RP) at PBD, 1D (if the non-offending team recovers).

front: Under what conditions is a first down awarded for a foul that is both UR/RP and illegal interference with a loose ball? Rule 8 | Section 5 | Article 7
back: First down is awarded for UR or RP by Team B (automatic) or is awarded for the Illegal Interference affecting the recovery of the loose ball by Team A.

front: What is the penalty when an Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP) foul also constitutes illegal interference affecting the recovery of a fumble or loose ball, and the non-offending team recovers? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 7
back: The non-offending team has the option of L15 (UR) or L25 (RP) from the Play By Dead (PBD), with an automatic 1st Down.

front: When does illegal interference affecting the recovery of a loose ball by Team A result in a first down? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 7
back: First down is awarded for the Illegal Interference affecting the recovery of the loose ball by Team A.

front: How is the penalty applied for a forward pass where illegal interference also includes Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP) committed by Team A? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 8
back: The penalty is L15 from the Point of Last Scrimmage (PLS) for Illegal Interference, plus L15 for UR or L25 for RP, and Down Repeated (DR).

front: How is the penalty applied for a forward pass where illegal interference also includes Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP) committed by Team B, and the Point of Foul (PF) is less than 15 yards from the Point of Last Scrimmage (PLS)? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 8
back: The penalty is L15 from the PF for UR or L25 for RP, and Team B receives a 1st Down.

front: What are Team B's options if Team A commits a foul during a successful convert attempt? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 9
back: Team B can either allow the score and apply the penalty on the kickoff; disallow the score, apply the penalty at the Point of Last Scrimmage (PLS), and repeat the convert; or disallow the score, repeat the convert at the PLS, and apply the penalty on the kickoff.

front: What are Team A's options if Team B commits a foul during a successful convert attempt? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 9
back: Team A can either accept the score and apply the penalty on the kickoff; decline the score, apply the penalty at the Point of Last Scrimmage (PLS), and repeat the convert; or decline the score, repeat the convert at the PLS, and apply the penalty on the kickoff.

front: What are Team B's options if Team A commits a foul before a score? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 10
back: Team B has the option of L15 from the Point of Last Scrimmage (PLS) and Down Repeated (DR), or from the Point By Holding (PBH) if the foul occurs after distance gained, or allowing the score and applying the penalty on the subsequent play.

front: When a foul occurs by either Team A or Team B after a score, how is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 10
back: The score is allowed, and the penalty will be applied on the subsequent play.

front: When a foul occurs after the ball has been declared dead, and the down has been used, where is the penalty applied? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 11
back: The penalty shall be applied at the Play By Dead (PBD).

front: What happens if a piling on foul occurs on a 3rd Down when the distance was not gained (DNG)? Rule 8 | Section 6 | Article 11
back: The ball is automatically awarded to Team B when it becomes dead, and the penalty for piling on cannot award the ball back to Team A, so the automatic 1st down penalty does not apply.

front: What defines a Dual Foul in a game? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 1
back: Dual Fouls occur when each team commits one or more fouls on the same play.

front: Under what condition does the dual penalty rule apply for accepted penalties? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 2
back: Both penalties must be accepted for the dual penalty rule to apply.

front: What happens if one team declines a penalty in a dual foul situation? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 2
back: If one team declines the penalty, the remaining penalty is applied as a single penalty.

front: How is a non-distance foul applied in a dual foul scenario? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 2
back: If one of the dual fouls is a non-distance foul, it shall be applied as a 10 yard (10 metre) penalty.

front: Is Pass Interference by Team B an automatic first down in a dual foul situation? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 2
back: No, Pass Interference by Team B is not an automatic first down in a dual foul situation.

front: What happens if both fouls are Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP) in a dual foul situation? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 2
back: Where both fouls are UR or RP, the automatic 1D for the B foul will not apply. The distance penalties will be adjusted at the appropriate point of application.

front: Where are penalties adjusted if the first foul is not Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP)? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 3
back: The penalties will be adjusted at the appropriate point of application of the first foul.

front: When the first foul is Unnecessary Roughness (UR) or Rough Play (RP), where can the non-offending team choose to adjust penalties? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 3
back: If the first foul is UR or RP, the non-offending team shall have the option of adjusting the penalties at the appropriate point of application of the first or second foul.

front: What choice does the non-offending team have when an opponent commits two or more infractions on the same play? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 4
back: The non-offending team may take its choice of one of the penalties.

front: What happens if one of the chosen fouls is UR or RP, Objectionable Conduct, or No Mouthguard when a team has committed multiple infractions? Rule 6 | Section: Dual and Double Fouls | Article 4
back: If one of the fouls is UR or RP, Objectionable Conduct, or No Mouthguard, it shall be added to the penalty chosen, at the point of application of the penalty chosen.

front: What action is considered screening? Rule 9 | Section 1 | Article 1
back: Screening is interference without direct contact.

front: How is tackling defined? Rule 9 | Section 1 | Article 2
back: Tackling is the act of grasping or encircling the ball carrier with the hands or arms.

front: Under what conditions may a team interfere with opponents anywhere within bounds? Rule 9 | Section 2 | Article 1
back: A team may interfere with opponents anywhere within bounds after legally recovering an opponent’s fumble, a dribbled ball, a blocked kick, a kickoff, a scrimmage kick, a return kick, or by intercepting an opponent’s pass.

front: What is the restriction on interference regarding body height? Rule 9 | Section 2 | Article 1
back: Interference is restricted to at or above the waist.

front: When do blocking above the waist restrictions lose significance regarding the line of scrimmage and neutral zone? Rule 9 | Section 2 | Article 1
back: Blocking above the waist restrictions lose significance when the ball has been touched by the opponents on a kick, or possession has changed on an intercepted pass, a blocked kick, or recovered fumble.

front: What is the penalty for a player interfering with an opponent attempting to recover a loose ball in the field of play? Rule 9 | Section 3 | Article 1-a
back: The ball is awarded to the non-offending team at the point of foul (PF) and an automatic 1st down.

front: What constitutes illegal interference with an opponent attempting to recover a loose ball? Rule 9 | Section 3 | Article 1-a
back: Interfering with an opponent attempting to recover a ball that is loose from a fumble, blocked kick, dribbled ball, or wild snap from centre.

front: Under what condition are players not penalized for illegal interference when making contact while attempting to recover a loose ball? Rule 9 | Section 3 | Article 1-b
back: Players who make contact in a simultaneous and bona fide effort to recover the ball shall not be penalized for illegal interference.

front: What does 'consecutive downs' mean in the context of possession in a series of downs? Rule 9 | Section 4 | Article 1
back: 'Consecutive' means possession in a continuous series of downs on which the ball is in possession of one team.

front: Under what conditions is the continuity of downs interrupted? Rule 9 | Section 4 | Article 2
back: The continuity of downs is interrupted when: a) Team A gains the required distance for first down. b) Team A fails on 3rd down to gain the required distance for 1st down. c) Team B obtains possession of the ball (recovering a fumble, intercepting a pass, by any other legal play, or by penalty). d) There is a loose ball on a play from scrimmages and Team B dribbles the ball. e) The ball is punted, drop kicked or place kicked over the line of scrimmage. f) The ball is kicked out of bounds, strikes the opponent’s goal post assembly in flight on a kick from scrimmage, is blocked directly out of bounds by Team B, or is last touched by Team B before going out of bounds. g) A score is made.

front: Does a ball dribbled over the line of scrimmage by Team A interrupt the continuity of downs? Rule 9 | Section 4 | Article 2
back: No, a ball dribbled over the line of scrimmage by A does NOT interrupt the continuity of downs.

front: When is 1st down awarded to Team A if they legally recover their own kick (not dribbled) over the line of scrimmage? Rule 9 | Section 4 | Article 2
back: 1st down is awarded to Team A only if the required distance for 1st down is gained, provided the ball was kicked (but NOT dribbled) by Team A over the line of scrimmage and is legally recovered by Team A before being touched by Team B across the line of scrimmage.
